skills.name: Starlit Grye Melody
lines: Consume Light Power from the Stellar Burst Gague equal to 8% of the gauge
* Intelligence and Speed of the user +100% and Apply Mental Focus on user (3 turns)
* Max MP of the user increases based on user's Light points (5 turns, Max 200 Light points: 100%)
* Once per turn: Stack 15 Guiding Stars on user (Max Stack 99)
* When lacking enough Light Power and not in Heavenly Power mode: Activate Starry Night instead
* When in Heavenly Power mode: Light power is not consumed and Guiding Stars is not Stacked.
